desc:
🍕 C.C. is hungry. Your job? Keep the pizza coming.

🖱️ Tap or hold C.C.’s face to earn slices!
🔥 Hire producers and unlock recipes to grow your pizza empire.
♻️ Rebirth for permanent boosts and Code Sigils.
✨ Unlock talents, colors and achievements.
🎁 Complete daily orders and catch special deliveries.
🏙️ Explore the café, meet its staff and discover hidden secrets.

Every 25th click serves a PERFECT slice worth 5×!

Unofficial fan-made clicker inspired by C.C. from Code Geass.
